input:
Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After “从早到晚一直祭拜,” add Mencius’s feeling to show why he keeps doing it, such as “孟子觉得祭拜很好玩。”
2. At the classmates’ teasing, add a short line of speech to make the scene more lively, such as “他们笑着说：‘你每天都在做什么？’”
3. Before the move, show the mother’s worry through an inner thought, such as “孟子妈妈心想：‘住在这里会影响孩子。’”

ideas.reason: It adds a simple, plausible feeling that explains why young Mencius keeps doing it.
It adds concrete dialogue to the classmates’ teasing without changing the scene.
It clearly shows the mother’s concern and supports her decision to move.
